Continuing astonishment, unending wonder, is the experience of those who traverse these circuits and tour these gigantic spheres. Monotony is not a part of the Havona career.

w03:189: No two worlds of Havona are alike (14:5.6). So the curiosity and love of adventure we carry within us now are not in vain.

w03:191.q: Love of adventure, curiosity, and dread of monotony—these traits inherent in evolving human nature—were not put there just to aggravate and annoy you during your short sojourn on earth, but rather to suggest to you that death is only the beginning of an endless career of adventure, an everlasting life of anticipation, an eternal voyage of discovery.

w03:193: Paper 14 calls this very urge a divine gift.

w03:195.q: Curiosity—the spirit of investigation, the urge of discovery, the drive of exploration—is a part of the inborn and divine endowment of evolutionary space creatures. These natural impulses were not given you merely to be frustrated and repressed.

w03:197: The longing to learn something new is a preview of eternity. Paper 14 sums up what Havona will be for us.

w03:199.q: Havona is the pre-Paradise training goal of every ascending mortal. … Havona stands before every will creature as the portal to Paradise and God attainment. Paradise is the home, and Havona the workshop and playground, of the finaliters.

w03:201: 4. The Seven Superuniverses and Our Address
w03:205: Beyond Havona lie the seven superuniverses, which grow and develop in time. The central universe and the seven superuniverses together are called the grand universe. Beyond them are four outer space levels still being organized, and all of this taken together is the master universe. Paper 15 likens the grand universe to a wheel.

w03:207.q: The Seven Master Spirits radiate their influence out from the central Isle, thus constituting the vast creation one gigantic wheel, the hub being the eternal Isle of Paradise, the seven spokes the radiations of the Seven Master Spirits, the rim the outer regions of the grand universe.

w03:209: The master universe in concentric rings — from Paradise outward (the author's summary based on Papers 11–15; sizes and distances not to scale)
w03:211: This wheel turns around its center.

w03:213.q: Your solar system and other worlds of time are not plunging headlong, without chart and compass, into unmapped space. The local universe to which your system belongs is pursuing a definite and well-understood counterclockwise course around the vast swing that encircles the central universe.

w03:215: Where on this wheel are we, then? Paper 12's answer is humbling.

w03:217.q: As we move from within, from the divine center outward in any one direction, we do, eventually, come to the outer limits of the organized and inhabited creation; we come to the outer limits of the grand universe. And it is near this outer border, in a far-off corner of such a magnificent creation, that your local universe has its eventful existence.

w03:219: From One Planet to the Grand Universe
w03:221: Paper 15 builds up a superuniverse in steps of about a hundred. Roughly a thousand inhabitable worlds make a system, a hundred systems make a constellation, and a hundred constellations make a local universe. Above that come the minor sector and the major sector, and finally the superuniverse, holding about a trillion worlds (15:2.3–8). Before setting out any numbers, though, the author says this:

w03:223.q: Only the Universal Father knows the location and actual number of inhabited worlds in space; he calls them all by name and number.

w03:225: Place our planet in this framework, and a long address appears. Paper 15 spells it out from the inside outward.

w03:227.q: Your world is called Urantia, and it is number 606 in the planetary group, or system, of Satania. … Satania has a headquarters world called Jerusem, and it is system number twenty-four in the constellation of Norlatiadek. … The universe of Nebadon is number eighty-four in the minor sector of Ensa. … This minor sector is number three in the major sector of Splandon. … It is the fifth major sector of the superuniverse of Orvonton, the seventh segment of the grand universe. Thus you can locate your planet in the scheme of the organization and administration of the universe of universes.

w03:229: Our cosmic address — from Urantia to the grand universe (the author's summary based on 15:2 and 15:14)
w03:231: The units of the grand universe and our address (15:2.3–9, 15:14.5–7)
w03:242: This address makes us small and great at the same time. One world among seven trillion looks insignificant. Yet once the author of Paper 15 has given the full address, he adds this:

w03:244.q: Your planet is a member of an enormous cosmos; you belong to a well-nigh infinite family of worlds, but your sphere is just as precisely administered and just as lovingly fostered as if it were the only inhabited world in all existence.

w03:246: Our superuniverse, Orvonton, also has a character of its own.

w03:248.q: Orvonton, the seventh superuniverse, the one to which your local universe belongs, is known chiefly because of its tremendous and lavish bestowal of merciful ministry to the mortals of the realms. … Orvonton is a universe demonstration of love and mercy.

w03:250: The Father's love, the Son's mercy, and the Spirit's ministry that we saw in section 1 are written into the very character of our superuniverse.
w03:253: **Havona**: The central universe of a billion perfect worlds surrounding Paradise. It did not evolve; it was created perfect from the beginning.
w03:254: **Grand universe**: The presently organized and inhabited creation, made up of Havona and the seven superuniverses. Add the outer space levels beyond it, and the whole is called the master universe.
w03:255: **Superuniverse**: One of the seven great creations evolving in time and space. We belong to the seventh, Orvonton, whose headquarters is Uversa.
w03:256: **Local universe**: A unit of about ten million worlds made and ruled by one Creator Son. Ours is Nebadon (Week 5).
w03:257: **Ancients of Days**: Rulers of Trinity origin who govern the superuniverses, three for each superuniverse.
w03:260: 5. How the Universe Holds Together — the Four Gravity Circuits
w03:264: Why do trillions of worlds circle in good order instead of flying apart? Paper 12 speaks of four circuits that hold the whole universe together.

w03:266.q: Personality also is responsive to gravity—to the Father's exclusive circuit; … the Universal Father is infinite and acts over all four absolute-gravity circuits in the master universe: 1. The Personality Gravity of the Universal Father. 2. The Spirit Gravity of the Eternal Son. 3. The Mind Gravity of the Conjoint Actor. 4. The Cosmic Gravity of the Isle of Paradise.

w03:268: The book uses the one word "gravity" for all four, but only the last of them pulls on matter. Physical gravity holds the stars and planets, and its center is the Isle of Paradise.

w03:270.q: Gravity is the all-powerful grasp of the physical presence of Paradise. Gravity is the omnipotent strand on which are strung the gleaming stars, blazing suns, and whirling spheres which constitute the universal physical adornment of the eternal God, who is all things, fills all things, and in whom all things consist.

w03:272: The stars are like beads strung on an unseen cord. But the universe holds more than matter. Whatever is spiritual is drawn toward the Eternal Son.

w03:274.q: Spirit realities respond to the drawing power of the center of spiritual gravity in accordance with their qualitative value, their actual degree of spirit nature. Spirit substance (quality) is just as responsive to spirit gravity as the organized energy of physical matter (quantity) is responsive to physical gravity. Spiritual values and spirit forces are real.

w03:276: Physical gravity pulls according to mass, that is, quantity; spirit gravity pulls according to spiritual value, that is, quality. Love, truth, and goodness are not vague feelings but realities that answer to an actual force in the universe. Nor does this pull weaken with distance.

w03:278.q: Spirit gravity never suffers time delays, nor does it undergo space diminution. It does not decrease in accordance with the square of the distance of its transmission; the circuits of pure spirit power are not retarded by the mass of the material creation.

w03:280: This pull works between people too.

w03:282.q: There is a direct attractiveness of a spirit nature between spiritually minded persons of like tastes and longings. The term kindred spirits is not wholly a figure of speech.

w03:284: Above all, spirit gravity has much to do with prayer.

w03:286.q: The spirit-gravity circuit is the basic channel for transmitting the genuine prayers of the believing human heart from the level of human consciousness to the actual consciousness of Deity. That which represents true spiritual value in your petitions will be seized by the universal circuit of spirit gravity and will pass immediately and simultaneously to all divine personalities concerned.

w03:288: A prayer gets through not because its words are grand but because it carries true spiritual value. The third circuit holds the mind.

w03:290.q: Much as the Father draws all personality to himself, and as the Son attracts all spiritual reality, so does the Conjoint Actor exercise a drawing power on all minds; he unqualifiedly dominates and controls the universal mind circuit. All true and genuine intellectual values, all divine thoughts and perfect ideas, are unerringly drawn into this absolute circuit of mind.

w03:292: The fourth, the Father's personality circuit, draws every person to the Father. The other three can be roughly estimated, but this one is different.

w03:294.q: Personality Gravity is noncomputable. We recognize the circuit, but we cannot measure either qualitative or quantitative realities responsive thereto.

w03:296: The close personal bond between the Father and each individual that we saw last week runs along this very circuit.
w03:298: The four circuits — four kinds of pull that draw all things to the center (the author's summary based on 12:3)
w03:300: All Roads Lead to the Center
w03:302: All four circuits lead back to Paradise. Trace any one of them upstream, and in the end it arrives at the same place.

w03:304.q: Here is God personally, literally, and actually present. And from his infinite being there flow the flood-streams of life, energy, and personality to all universes.

w03:306: Not even rebellion can cut this pull.

w03:308.q: Sin and rebellion may interfere with the operation of local universe circuits, but nothing can suspend the spirit gravity of the Eternal Son.

w03:310: Our planet was quarantined after the Lucifer rebellion (Week 7), yet the spirit gravity of the Eternal Son works here just as it does everywhere else. As the stars circle their center, so our souls were made from the start to turn toward the center.
w03:313: **Spirit gravity**: The pull that draws all spiritual realities and values to the Eternal Son. Unlike physical gravity, it does not weaken with distance (7:1.2).
w03:314: **Mind gravity**: The pull that draws all minds and all true intellectual values to the Infinite Spirit.
w03:315: **Dark gravity bodies**: Enormous bodies that encircle Havona in two belts and balance the gravity of Paradise. They neither reflect nor absorb light.
w03:319: The Universal Father, the Eternal Son, and the Infinite Spirit are the "original family," together from eternity, and their union is the Paradise Trinity.
w03:320: God is love, the Son is mercy, the Spirit is ministry (8:4.2). The Son's mercy flows from the Father's love.
w03:321: Paradise is a real Isle at the center of the universe, the dwelling place of the Deities and the final destination of ascending mortals.
w03:322: Havona is a billion perfect worlds surrounding Paradise, created perfect from the start, the pattern for all universes and a "university of surprises."
w03:323: Havona and the seven superuniverses make up the grand universe, and we live near the outer edge of the seventh superuniverse, Orvonton.
w03:324: Urantia's address: world 606 of Satania, Norlatiadek, Nebadon, Ensa, Splandon, Orvonton.
w03:325: Four circuits, personality gravity, spirit gravity, mind gravity, and cosmic gravity, draw all things toward Paradise.
w03:329: If you carried the sentence "God is love, the Son is mercy, the Spirit is ministry" (8:4.2) into the relationships of your own life, what would each part look like?
w03:330: You live on one world among seven trillion, yet it is "lovingly fostered as if it were the only inhabited world" (15:14.9). How does this change the way you see your own place?
w03:331: If spirit gravity answers to quality rather than quantity (7:1.3), which of today's prayers and choices might that circuit take hold of?
w03:335: Papers 16–31 — The great family of the grand universe: the Seven Master Spirits, the Sons of God, the angels, and the big picture of ascension from mortal to finaliter
w04:1: The Great Family of the Grand Universe
w04:2: Paper 15:10 · Paper 16 · Paper 18:3 · Papers 20–21 · Papers 24, 26 · Paper 30:4 · Paper 31
w04:3: This week's map — from the rulers of the superuniverses, the Sons of God and the children of the Infinite Spirit to the seven stages of ascent and the Corps of the Finality
w04:6: Papers 16 to 31 pour out the names of beings most readers have never heard of, yet every one of these orders is turned toward a single task: bringing the mortals of time to the perfection of Paradise. The Sons of God and the angelic family of the Infinite Spirit help along the way, while a human being travels from a creature of flesh and blood, through morontia and spirit, to Paradise and the Corps of the Finality. This week the aim is not to memorize names but to see how this great family fits together, and where we stand within it.
w04:11: Picture someone newly married, arriving for the first big holiday gathering of their spouse's extended family. Every room is full of unfamiliar faces: uncles, great-aunts, second cousins, cousins' spouses. Trying to work out who is related to whom soon makes the head spin.
w04:13: By the end of the day, though, something becomes clear. They all come from the same root, and they have gathered partly to welcome the newcomer. The names can be learned slowly. What matters first is knowing that one has been welcomed into the family.
w04:15: Papers 16 to 31 of The Urantia Book are that crowded house. Master Spirits, Ancients of Days, Creator Sons, supernaphim, finaliters: the names arrive one after another. This week we take a family tree in hand and begin by asking why this great family has gathered at all.
w04:17: 1. The Seven Master Spirits and the Rulers of the Superuniverses
w04:21: As we saw in Week 3, seven superuniverses circle around Havona. Watching over these seven divisions from the very top are the Seven Master Spirits of Paradise. Paper 16 opens by explaining why there are exactly seven.

w04:23.q: The Seven Master Spirits of Paradise are the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit. In this sevenfold creative act of self-duplication the Infinite Spirit exhausted the associative possibilities mathematically inherent in the factual existence of the three persons of Deity. Had it been possible to produce a larger number of Master Spirits, they would have been created, but there are just seven associative possibilities, and only seven, inherent in three Deities. And this explains why the universe is operated in seven grand divisions, and why the number seven is basically fundamental in its organization and administration.

w04:25: Take the Father, the Son, and the Spirit singly, in pairs, and all three together, and exactly seven combinations result. Each Master Spirit reflects one of these combinations and oversees one superuniverse. That is why the seven superuniverses all serve the same God and yet each carries a color of its own.
w04:27: From three to seven — the seven associations of the three Deities and the Seven Master Spirits (compiled by the author from 16:0.2-9 and 16:3)
w04:29: Our own superuniverse, Orvonton, the seventh, is in the care of Master Spirit Number Seven, who reflects all three persons equally.

w04:31.q: This Master Spirit is always in liaison with the Reflective Spirits of Uversa, the headquarters of the seventh superuniverse, our own segment of creation. His administration of Orvonton discloses the marvelous symmetry of the co-ordinate blending of the divine natures of Father, Son, and Spirit.

w04:33: This is more than a distant organizational chart. Paper 16 says that creatures born in each superuniverse carry the character of its Master Spirit with them forever.

w04:35.q: Through this personal influence of the Seven Master Spirits every creature of every order of intelligent beings, outside of Paradise and Havona, must bear the characteristic stamp of individuality indicative of the ancestral nature of some one of these Seven Paradise Spirits. As concerns the seven superuniverses, each native creature, man or angel, will forever bear this badge of natal identification.

w04:37.q: The distinctive personality trends exhibited in the life experience of evolutionary mortals, which are characteristic in each superuniverse, and which are directly expressive of the nature of the dominating Master Spirit, are never fully effaced, not even after such ascenders are subjected to the long training and unifying discipline encountered on the one billion educational spheres of Havona. Even the subsequent intense Paradise culture does not suffice to eradicate the earmarks of superuniverse origin. Throughout all eternity an ascendant mortal will exhibit traits indicative of the presiding Spirit of his superuniverse of nativity.

w04:39: Just as a hometown accent stays with a person for life, someone born in Orvonton remains an Orvonton native forever. Within us is the imprint of Master Spirit Number Seven, who resembles the Father, the Son, and the Spirit in equal measure.
w04:43: The Master Spirits remain on Paradise. The actual administration at the capital of each superuniverse belongs to others: the Ancients of Days, who rule together in groups of three. The capital of our superuniverse is Uversa. Paper 18 divides the work of the two groups like this.

w04:45.q: The Seven Master Spirits on high determine the nature of their respective superuniverses, but the Ancients of Days dictate the administration of these same superuniverses. They superimpose administrative uniformity on creative diversity and insure the harmony of the whole in the face of the underlying creational differences of the seven segmental groupings of the grand universe.

w04:47: If the Master Spirits shape the character of each superuniverse, the Ancients of Days see that seven quite different superuniverses are governed by the same principles. Their authority is very great, but it is not meant to last unchanged forever.

w04:49.q: Aside from the Deities and their Paradise associates, the Ancients of Days are the most perfect, most versatile, and the most divinely endowed rulers in all time-space existence. Apparently they are the supreme rulers of the superuniverses; but they have not experientially earned this right to rule and are therefore destined sometime to be superseded by the Supreme Being, an experiential sovereign, whose vicegerents they will undoubtedly become.

w04:51: We will meet the Supreme Being again in Week 10. Working alongside these three rulers are several groups of high beings.
w04:53: The seven groups of the superuniverse government (compiled by the author from 15:10.3-12)
w04:58: The order that wrote the Foreword and Paper 1
w04:60: Former mortals embraced by the Trinity
w04:61: Former mortals embraced by the Trinity
w04:62: Former mortals embraced by the Trinity
w04:64: The last three rows are remarkable. Among the members of the highest government of the universe are beings who were once mortals, born on a planet just as we were.

w04:66.q: The remaining three orders, Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, and Those without Name and Number, are glorified ascendant mortals. The first of these orders came up through the ascendant regime and passed through Havona in the days of Grandfanda. Having attained Paradise, they were mustered into the Corps of the Finality, embraced by the Paradise Trinity, and subsequently assigned to the supernal service of the Ancients of Days. … Thus was the executive branch of the superuniverse government enlarged to include the glorified and perfected children of the evolutionary worlds.

w04:68: Paper 30, which describes the seven stages of ascent we will look at later, was itself sponsored by a Mighty Messenger of Uversa. It is as though an elder who has walked the road in person is showing the way to those who come after.
w04:70: A great many beings appear in these papers, but not everything has been revealed. Paper 16 explains how the selection was made.

w04:72.q: Much, very much, of the activity of the Seven Master Spirits remains hidden from human understanding because in no way does it directly pertain to your problem of Paradise ascent.

w04:74: This sentence is the key to reading this week's papers. Most of the beings introduced in the book are connected with our ascent. When an unfamiliar name appears, a good question to ask is how this being relates to the road a mortal travels. Paper 16 also gives these seven Spirits a name familiar from the Bible.

w04:76.q: It is literally true that these Seven Spirits are the personalized physical power, cosmic mind, and spiritual presence of the triune Deity, "the Seven Spirits of God sent forth to all the universe."

w04:79: **Master Spirits**: The primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit; seven in number, they each oversee one of the seven superuniverses from Paradise.
w04:80: **Ancients of Days**: Trinity-origin rulers of a superuniverse, three of whom govern each superuniverse together.
w04:81: **Mighty Messenger**: A former mortal who reached Paradise, was embraced by the Trinity, and now serves in a superuniverse government.
w04:85: The Book of Revelation speaks of "the seven Spirits which are before his throne" (Revelation 1:4; see also 4:5). The phrase "the Seven Spirits of God" in 16:4.1 echoes this. Daniel's vision of "the Ancient of days" seated in judgment (Daniel 7:9) likewise comes to mind with the name Ancients of Days.
w04:92: In this book "Son of God" does not refer to just one being. Many orders are called sons, and Paper 20 sorts them into three broad groups: descending Sons, ascending sons, and Trinitized Sons.

w04:94.q: Descending orders of sonship include personalities who are of direct and divine creation. Ascending sons, such as mortal creatures, achieve this status by experiential participation in the creative technique known as evolution. Trinitized Sons are a group of composite origin which includes all beings embraced by the Paradise Trinity even though not of direct Trinity origin.

w04:96: Descending Sons are created perfect and come down to serve. Ascending sons are born below and grow upward. Human beings are ascending sons. The Mighty Messengers we met above, having ascended and then been embraced by the Trinity, belong to the third group.
w04:98: The Sons of God — Sons who descend, sons who ascend, and Trinitized Sons (compiled by the author from 20:0-1 and 22:0)
w04:100: Sons Who Come Down from Above
w04:102: Among the descending Sons are three orders that come from Paradise: the Creator Sons (Michaels), the Magisterial Sons (Avonals), and the Trinity Teacher Sons (Daynals). Paper 20 sums up which face of Deity each one shows.

w04:104.q: As the Father of a local universe, a Creator Son portrays the infinite character of the Universal Father. As the bestowal Sons of mercy, the Avonals reveal the matchless nature of the Eternal Son of infinite compassion. As the true teachers of ascending personalities, the Trinity Daynal Sons disclose the teacher personality of the Infinite Spirit.

w04:106: There are vast numbers of them, yet when one of them serves a world, he serves it as though it were the only world.

w04:108.q: All the Paradise Sons of God are divine in origin and in nature. The work of each Paradise Son in behalf of each world is just as if the Son of service were the first and only Son of God.

w04:110: The Creator Son of Our Universe
w04:112: A Creator Son makes and rules a single local universe. Paper 21 begins with his name.

w04:114.q: These primary Paradise Sons are personalized as Michaels. As they go forth from Paradise to found their universes, they are known as Creator Michaels. When settled in supreme authority, they are called Master Michaels. Sometimes we refer to the sovereign of your universe of Nebadon as Christ Michael.

w04:116: The book teaches that Michael of Nebadon lived on this world as Jesus of Nazareth. Paper 21 compares his relationship with the Father to the love between parents and children.

w04:118.q: In the vast work of organizing, evolving, and perfecting a local universe, these high Sons always enjoy the sustaining approval of the Universal Father. The relationship of the Creator Sons with their Paradise Father is touching and superlative. No doubt the profound affection of the Deity parents for their divine progeny is the wellspring of that beautiful and well-nigh divine love which even mortal parents bear their children.

w04:120: The tenderness parents feel for their children is a stream flowing from that spring. Nor is the order of Michael made up of beings who only issue commands from on high.

w04:122.q: The order of Michael knows the grand universe from one end to the other; there is no essential experience of any of the children of time and space in which the Michaels have not personally participated; they are in fact partakers not only of the divine nature but also of your nature, meaning all natures, from the highest to the lowest.

w04:124: A Creator Son lives seven times in the likeness of the creatures he has made. This is called a bestowal. Why, then, did a Son of God come as a human being? Paper 20 addresses one widely held idea.

w04:126.q: On Urantia there is a widespread belief that the purpose of a Son's bestowal is, in some manner, to influence the attitude of the Universal Father. But your enlightenment should indicate that this is not true. The bestowals of the Avonal and the Michael Sons are a necessary part of the experiential process designed to make these Sons safe and sympathetic magistrates and rulers of the peoples and planets of time and space. The career of sevenfold bestowal is the supreme goal of all Paradise Creator Sons.

w04:128: The Father is love from the beginning. A bestowal is not an attempt to change that love; it is the way a Son comes to know creature life from the inside and so becomes a sympathetic ruler. The way involves real risk, yet the Sons always come through.

w04:130.q: They indeed assume the risk, really become like the mortal creatures of flesh and blood and thereby gain the unique creature experience, but within the range of my observation they always succeed. They never fail to achieve the goal of the bestowal mission. The story of their bestowal and planetary service throughout Nebadon constitutes the most noble and fascinating chapter in the history of your local universe.

w04:132: One of those noblest chapters was written on this very planet. We will return to that story in Weeks 11 and 12.
w04:135: **Common misunderstanding**: The Son of God came as a man to appease an angry Father and change His mind.
w04:136: **What The Urantia Book says**: The purpose of a bestowal is not to alter the Father's attitude (20:5.2). The Son experiences creature life for himself, becomes a sympathetic ruler, and reveals the Father's love to His creatures.
w04:140: **Creator Son**: A Paradise Son, born of the Father and the Eternal Son, who makes and rules a local universe; also called a Michael.
w04:141: **Magisterial Son**: A Paradise Son of the Son and the Spirit, called an Avonal, who judges planets and sometimes bestows himself.
w04:142: **Trinity Teacher Son**: A Daynal, born of the Father, Son, and Spirit, who teaches throughout the universes.
w04:143: **bestowal**: The act of a descending Son who is born in the likeness of a creature and lives that life in person.
w04:146: 3. The Children of the Infinite Spirit — the Great Family of Angels
w04:150: Beside the Sons of God stands another great family, the offspring of the Infinite Spirit. Paper 26 begins by saying what angels are.

w04:152.q: Angels are the ministering-spirit associates of the evolutionary and ascending will creatures of all space; they are also the colleagues and working associates of the higher hosts of the divine personalities of the spheres. The angels of all orders are distinct personalities and are highly individualized. … they possess very social natures and have an associative capacity far transcending that of human beings.

w04:154: Angels are not winged errand-runners; each is a person with a character of his own. The authors on Uversa divide this whole family into three groups.

w04:156.q: On Uversa we divide all personalities and entities of the Conjoint Creator into three grand divisions: the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit, the Messenger Hosts of Space, and the Ministering Spirits of Time, those spirit beings who are concerned with teaching and ministering to the will creatures of the ascendant scheme of mortal progression.

w04:158: The highest group includes higher personalities such as the Solitary Messengers, who travel the universe alone. The Messenger Hosts in the middle link the other two. Closest to us is the third group, the ministering spirits: the angels.
w04:160: The great family of the Infinite Spirit — three groups, and the angelic chain from Paradise down to the planets (compiled by the author from 24:0 and 26:1)
w04:164: Angels are named according to where they serve. Paper 28 sets the three orders side by side in a single sentence.

w04:166.q: As the supernaphim are the angelic hosts of the central universe and the seraphim of the local universes, so are the seconaphim the ministering spirits of the superuniverses.

w04:168: They are not separate crews working in isolation; together they form one chain.

w04:170.q: …it is the supernaphim, seconaphim, and seraphim who, in large numbers, are employed in the furtherance of the ascending scheme of progressive perfection for the children of time. Functioning in the central, super-, and local universes, they form that unbroken chain of spirit ministers which has been provided by the Infinite Spirit for the help and guidance of all who seek to attain the Universal Father through the Eternal Son.

w04:172: It works much like a relay race. On the planet the seraphim care for us; in the superuniverse the seconaphim take the baton; in Havona and on Paradise the supernaphim run the final stretch beside us. On no leg of the journey is an ascender left alone. That is why the first thing a new arrival in Havona does is give thanks.

w04:174.q: The first act of your Havona career will be to recognize and thank your transport seconaphim for the long and safe journey. Then you are presented to those beings who will sponsor your early Havona activities. Next you go to register your arrival and prepare your message of thanksgiving and adoration for dispatch to the Creator Son of your local universe, the universe Father who made possible your sonship career.

w04:176: Angels, too, are not fixed in place.

w04:178.q: The individual members of the angelic orders are not altogether stationary as to personal status in the universe. … Certain of the cherubim may aspire to seraphic status and destiny, while evolutionary seraphim can achieve the spiritual levels of the ascending Sons of God.

w04:180: Some of the seraphim who once watched over mortals go on to enter the Corps of the Finality with them (31:0.5).
w04:182: The high beings of this week at a glance (compiled by the author from Papers 16, 18, 20, 21, 24, 26)
w04:185: Shape each superuniverse; leave the stamp of our birth
w04:186: Take us in as superuniverse wards
w04:187: Father of our universe; pours out the Spirit of Truth
w04:188: Judges planetary ages; wakes the sleeping survivors
w04:190: Guardian angels of planetary and morontia life
w04:191: Help in superuniverse life; carry us to Havona
w04:192: Guide the Havona pilgrimage and Paradise worship
w04:195: **Common misunderstanding**: When people die, they become angels.
w04:196: **What The Urantia Book says**: Angels are children of the Infinite Spirit, an order distinct from human beings (24:0.1). After death a human being awakens as a morontia being and grows on toward spirit. The two are born differently, but they walk the same road together.
w04:200: The Letter to the Hebrews calls the angels "ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation" (Hebrews 1:14). This is the same idea as the book's ministering spirits, and The Urantia Book adds that this service reaches all the way to Paradise.
w04:203: 4. From Mortal to Finaliter — the Seven Stages of Ascent
w04:207: Now we come to the one this great family exists to help: the human being. Paper 30 portrays the universe career of an ascending mortal in seven stages. The author first explains why the story is told this way.

w04:209.q: The following narrative presents the universe career of an Adjuster-indwelt mortal. … we have elected to tell this story as it pertains to the Adjuster-fused mortals, for such a destiny may be anticipated by all of the human races of Urantia.

w04:211: The seven stages are planetary mortals, sleeping survivors, mansion world students, morontia progressors, superuniverse wards, Havona pilgrims, and Paradise arrivals. Mortals at the starting line may look different from planet to planet, but they all receive the same care.

w04:213.q: Mortals are all animal-origin evolutionary beings of ascendant potential. … The human races of each world receive the same ministry of the Sons of God and enjoy the presence of the ministering spirits of time. After natural death all types of ascenders fraternize as one morontia family on the mansion worlds.

w04:215: Not everyone passes through the second stage. Many awaken directly on the mansion worlds, in the third. What carries a person across death? Paper 30 answers this way.

w04:217.q: The Adjuster is the custodian of the spirit transcript of the mind of the sleeping survivor. The assigned seraphim is the keeper of the surviving identity—the immortal soul—as far as it has evolved. And when these two, the Adjuster and the seraphim, reunite their personality trusts, the new individual constitutes the resurrection of the old personality, the survival of the evolving morontia identity of the soul.

w04:219: We will look closely at the first steps after death, and at the mansion worlds, in Week 6.
w04:221: The seven stages of ascent — from flesh and blood through morontia and spirit to Paradise (compiled by the author from 30:4.2-31)
w04:225: Paper 30 invites the Havona pilgrim to look back over the road traveled.

w04:227.q: On earth you were a creature of flesh and blood; through the local universe you were a morontia being; through the superuniverse you were an evolving spirit; with your arrival on the receiving worlds of Havona your spiritual education begins in reality and in earnest; your eventual appearance on Paradise will be as a perfected spirit.

w04:229: "Morontia" names the intermediate reality between matter and spirit. A human being does not leap straight from a material body into spirit but crosses a long bridge in between. Even in the passage from morontia to spirit, only the form changes.

w04:231.q: The mind, personality, and character are unchanged by such an advance; only does the form undergo modification. But the spirit form is just as real as the morontia body, and it is equally discernible.

w04:233: Around the time of leaving the local universe comes a decisive confirmation.

w04:235.q: From this point on, the status of the ascending mortal is forever settled. Superuniverse wards have never been known to go astray.

w04:237: The One Perfection Carried into Havona
w04:239: What does a pilgrim bring after the long ascent to Havona? Paper 26 gives a surprisingly modest answer.

w04:241.q: When, through and by the ministry of all the helper hosts of the universal scheme of survival, you are finally deposited on the receiving world of Havona, you arrive with only one sort of perfection—perfection of purpose. Your purpose has been thoroughly proved; your faith has been tested. You are known to be disappointment proof. Not even the failure to discern the Universal Father can shake the faith or seriously disturb the trust of an ascendant mortal who has passed through the experience that all must traverse in order to attain the perfect spheres of Havona. By the time you reach Havona, your sincerity has become sublime.

w04:243: Even on reaching Havona, the ascender is not yet perfect in every way. Only one thing is perfect: the purpose of going to the Father. What is asked of us today is the seed of that purpose. And this is where the road leads.

w04:245.q: Your residence on Paradise signifies that you have found God, and that you are to be mustered into the Mortal Corps of the Finality.

w04:247: The first thing learned on Paradise is worship. Paper 27 describes it like this.

w04:249.q: Worship is the highest joy of Paradise existence; it is the refreshing play of Paradise. What play does for your jaded minds on earth, worship will do for your perfected souls on Paradise.

w04:251: Each great milestone of the ascent is also celebrated. Paper 27 lists seven jubilees.
w04:253: The seven jubilees of the ascent (27:7.8)
w04:256: The agreement with the Thought Adjuster, when the purpose to survive was sealed
w04:257: The awakening in the morontia life
w04:260: The finding of the Universal Father
w04:261: The Paradise awakening from the final transit slumber
w04:262: Entrance into the mortal finaliter corps and the start of eternal service
w04:265: **morontia**: The intermediate level of reality between matter and spirit; after death a person awakens in a morontia body.
w04:266: **ascending pilgrim**: The name for a mortal survivor who has been cleared for the progressive ascent toward Paradise.
w04:267: **Adjuster fusion**: The eternal union of a human soul with the indwelling Thought Adjuster; we will look at it closely in Week 10.
w04:270: 5. Made for Adventure — the Destiny of the Corps of the Finality
w04:272: Not an Ending but a Beginning
w04:274: Arrival on Paradise is not the end; it is a graduation and a fresh start. The ascenders enter the Corps of the Finality, and even there no one's individual face is erased.

w04:276.q: All the ascendant creatures admitted to this corps are received in equality, but this exalted equality in no way abrogates individuality or destroys personal identity.

w04:278: Nor are the finaliters only in far-off places.

w04:280.q: One or more companies of the mortal finaliters are constantly in service on Urantia.

w04:282: Elders who have completed the long ascent are at work on this very planet now. Paper 31 calls them the salt of the universe.

w04:284.q: They are indeed the accumulating tried and true souls of time and space—the evolutionary salt of the universe—and they are forever proof against evil and secure against sin.

w04:286: Those who have climbed from below can give something that beings created perfect from the start cannot: the experience of wrestling with evil and choosing the good for themselves.
w04:290: The final destiny of the finaliters has not yet been revealed. The authors say frankly that they do not know, and they invite the reader to wonder along with them.

w04:292.q: We deem that human beings are entitled to share our opinions, and that you are free to conjecture with us respecting the mystery of the ultimate destiny of the Paradise Corps of Finality. It seems evident to us that the present assignments of the perfected evolutionary creatures partake of the nature of postgraduate courses in universe understanding and superuniverse administration; and we all ask, "Why should the Gods be so concerned in so thoroughly training surviving mortals in the technique of universe management?"

w04:294: The authors cautiously offer one guess.

w04:296.q: We think we know their future work, but we are not certain. While the Corps of the Mortal Finality is mobilizing on Paradise, and while they now so extensively minister to the universes of space and administer the worlds settled in light and life, their future destination must be the now-organizing universes of outer space. At least that is the conjecture of Uversa.

w04:298: Since the authors themselves call this a conjecture, it should not be read as settled teaching. What is certain is that the ascent leads not to retirement but to preparation for greater service. The finaliters have achieved all that the road so far could give them, yet something lies beyond it still.

w04:300.q: The mortal finaliters have fully complied with the injunction of the ages, "Be you perfect"; they have ascended the universal path of mortal attainment; they have found God, and they have been duly inducted into the Corps of the Finality. Such beings have attained the present limit of spirit progression but not finality of ultimate spirit status.

w04:302: Paper 31 gathers the whole long road into a single sentence and closes with a cry of wonder.

w04:304.q: Evolutionary mortals are born on the planets of space, pass through the morontia worlds, ascend the spirit universes, traverse the Havona spheres, find God, attain Paradise, and are mustered into the primary Corps of the Finality, therein to await the next assignment of universe service. … And as we view this sublime spectacle, we all exclaim: What a glorious destiny for the animal-origin children of time, the material sons of space!

w04:306: The Spirit of Adventure Within Us
w04:308: A restless mind that is always looking for something new and cannot stand boredom is often treated as a habit to be cured. The Urantia Book sees it differently.

w04:310.q: Love of adventure, curiosity, and dread of monotony—these traits inherent in evolving human nature—were not put there just to aggravate and annoy you during your short sojourn on earth, but rather to suggest to you that death is only the beginning of an endless career of adventure, an everlasting life of anticipation, an eternal voyage of discovery.

w04:312: The unfamiliar relatives in that crowded house turned out to be people gathered to welcome the newcomer. The great family of the grand universe is the same. From the Master Spirits to the seraphim, all those names are helping hands, reaching out so that each person may come to the Father. Next week we descend from this large picture to the home closest to us: our local universe, Nebadon.
w04:315: "Be you perfect" in 31:3.6 is the same command as the Sermon on the Mount: "Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect" (Matthew 5:48). Paul's words about what "eye hath not seen, nor ear heard" (1 Corinthians 2:9) also bring to mind the finaliters' destiny, which has not yet been revealed.
w04:319: The Seven Master Spirits express the seven associations of the three Deities, and each oversees one superuniverse. Orvonton is in the care of Master Spirit Number Seven.
w04:320: The Ancients of Days rule the superuniverses, and glorified ascendant mortals serve with them in the superuniverse government.
w04:321: The Sons of God fall into three groups: descending Sons, ascending sons, and Trinitized Sons. Human beings are ascending sons.
w04:322: A Creator Son's bestowal is not meant to change the Father's heart; it is the way a Son experiences creature life and becomes a sympathetic ruler.
w04:323: The supernaphim, seconaphim, and seraphim form an unbroken chain of angels from Paradise down to the planets.
w04:324: In the seven stages of ascent, a human being passes from flesh and blood through morontia and spirit to Paradise.
w04:325: Arrival on Paradise is not the end but the beginning of a greater service in the Corps of the Finality.
w04:329: Of the beings you met this week, which one stays with you most? How is that being connected with your own ascent?
w04:330: The one perfection carried into Havona is "perfection of purpose" (26:4.13). What comfort and what challenge does this bring to your life of faith today?
w04:331: If you saw your own curiosity and love of adventure as a foretaste of an eternal voyage (14:5.10), how might your attitude toward today's life change?
